supportPage.faq1Q: How do I register my product for warranty?
supportPage.faq1A: You can register your product by logging into your portal account, navigating to 'My Products', and clicking on 'Register New Device'. You will need your serial number and invoice date.
supportPage.faq2Q: Can I update the firmware on my own?
supportPage.faq2A: Yes, all smart controllers and connected seeders support wireless over-the-air (OTA) updates via the GBRU Mobile App.
supportPage.faq3Q: Where can I find my nearest service center?
supportPage.faq3A: Use our interactive Find Dealer search tool by entering your zip code or region to find authorized service centers near you.

warranty.termsText: By clicking Register, you agree to our
warranty.benefit1Desc: Prioritized service tickets and dedicated support channels for registered users.
warranty.benefit2Desc: Ensure your product is authentic and covered by our comprehensive manufacturer warranty.
warranty.benefit3Desc: Be the first to receive firmware updates, optimization tips, and safety announcements.
warranty.benefit4Desc: Paperless claim process. Your product details are already in our system for quick access.
warranty.successSubtext: Your Seeder Pro X is now protected under our full enterprise coverage. High-performance cultivation starts with peace of mind.
warranty.faq1Q: How long is the standard warranty period?
warranty.faq1A: The standard warranty period varies by product category. Most agricultural equipment comes with a 1-year comprehensive warranty from the date of purchase.
warranty.faq2Q: Is the warranty transferable to a new owner?
warranty.faq2A: Warranties are generally non-transferable and apply only to the original purchaser.
warranty.faq3Q: What documents are needed for service claims?
warranty.faq3A: To process a service claim, you will need a valid purchase invoice from an authorized dealer, the product serial number, and a completed warranty registration.
